glanceItems.label: Product Highlights
glanceItems.value: Lyophilized Solid Active-Lock Form  Lyophilized at low temperature to preserve active nutrients, reducing reliance on preservatives. Upon contact with the intimate environment, it gradually releases nutrients—no messy dripping, for a cleaner and more discreet experience.

blocks.heading: Key Ingredients
blocks.body:
Pullulan: Forms a breathable protective film that locks in mucosal moisture, soothing and protecting.
Sodium Hyaluronate + Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate:** Multi-layer hydration that nourishes delicate intimate mucosa and improves dryness.
β-Glucan: Soothes and stabilizes, strengthening the mucosal barrier.
Hydrolyzed Collagen + Soluble Collagen:** Replenishes collagen for a soft, supple feel.
Oligopeptide-1, Tetrapeptide-4, Glycoprotein:** Multiple active peptides that care for the mucosa and help maintain a healthy intimate state.
Glyceryl Citrate / Lactate / Linoleate / Oleate:** Mimics the sebum feel of mucosa, providing soft hydration and helping maintain a mildly acidic environment.
Trace Fragrance: Aromatic ingredients that create different scent profiles and help neutralize unwanted odors (the source of variation across the 8 scents).

blocks.heading: Instructions for Use
blocks.body:
1.Clean hands thoroughly
2.Put on the disposable finger cot
3.Take out lyophilized ball, gently insert deep into vagina

Note：The ball will gradually dissolve and release nutrients under intimate environment.
